public_policy_facts_to_cover: Task text, task counts, game progress, companions and settings are retained locally.
No app account, developer cloud synchronization, advertising, tracking or sale of data.
Uninstalling deletes local app data; exporting/importing backups is the user's choice.
Chosen Files/share providers may store an exported backup under their own policies.
Provide a real operator/contact and policy date. Publish a reachable privacy-policy page and include a link inside the app.
Published policy/support source pages use confirmed developer MiuraKenichi and a public GitHub Issues channel; no private email is exposed.

native_source_facts.game_content: Bundled file URL only; the embedded webview rejects external navigation. User-activated HTTP(S) links open outside the game webview.
native_source_facts.save_copy: Version-4 JSON in the app Application Support container, with file protection.
native_source_facts.reminders: Explicit opt-in from settings; UNUserNotificationCenter local deadline reminder with fixed text and no task title. The game Time Announcements setting must also be on. No APNs registration or remote notification server.
native_source_facts.speech: AVSpeechSynthesizer ja-JP output; no recording or recognition.
native_source_facts.haptics: UIKit feedback generators for attack/skill/result output.
native_source_facts.backup: UIActivityViewController export and user-selected JSON UIDocumentPicker import; no developer upload endpoint.
